1090362840._comment: Avon Park Theater (71 Genesee, 1938) + two absorbed neighbours to its north: the narrow white flat-roof 2-storey (Integrity Tours / 'Wedding Flowers by Avon Floral World') and the white clapboard gable of Avon Floral World (63 Genesee). Road face +u; left (fraction 0) = +v = SSW.

signs._comment: marquee fascia hung at the front edge of the white canopy
vertical PARK blade: single-letter boards stacked in front of the dark tower

volumes._comment: narrow white 2-storey between the theater and the gable (Integrity Tours 2023 / wedding-flowers shop 2025)
Avon Floral World, white clapboard gable-front, burgundy trim
narrow single-storey wing running back behind the florist
Raised dark blade ahead of the upper window frames; bottom is above the entrance canopy.

1090362841._comment: 59 Genesee St: narrow 2-storey flat-roof shop, buff random-ashlar stone veneer over a red-brick storefront on the street face, red-brick sides, white membrane roof. Road face +v (facade runs along u, 7.4 m); left (fraction 0) = -u = SSW.

volumes._comment: thin stone-faced front slab: brick below the canopy, tan ashlar above, stone coping

248251397._comment: T's On Genesee Market & Deli, 90 Genesee St. White clapboard 2-storey flat-roofed commercial block, sage-green window trim, bracketed cornice, storefront on a tan-brick kick with red (umbrella) accents. Road face +u. Volume is 1 m narrower than the OBB on the +v side to leave the real ~2.3 m alley to the laundromat (78).

248251398._comment: Coyne Econ-O-Wash laundromat, 78 Genesee St. Tall white-clapboard Second Empire front on a red-brick storefront base: bracketed cornice, black mansard (front section only), pedimented gable with oculus on top, two hooded upper windows, gold-on-black sign. A white gabled block with a brick-based rear runs behind. Road face -u. Volumes stop 1 m short of the OBB on the +v side to leave the real ~2.3 m alley to T's (90).

volumes._comment: Thin post hidden inside the mansard; it only exists to carry the pediment up onto the mansard cap.

248251399._comment: Community Bank, 68 Genesee St. Low tan-sided branch on a red-brick base, shallow dark gable, glass atrium at the NW corner, tan clock tower at the north end of the street face, clerestory monitor along the ridge, drive-through canopy on the north side.

248274518._comment: Avon Farmers Market: one open timber gable shelter with exposed king-post trusses, cafe seating and a low entrance fence. Matched to the user-provided photo.

248290078._comment: Avon Inn, 55 East Main St. The front is the +u face (NNE, East Main St): five-bay Greek Revival block with a two-storey portico of four giant columns and an AVON INN entablature, the colonnade returning along the Temple St (-v) side of the main block. White clapboard rear wings: a flat-roofed west wing with a bracketed pent roof and stairs on Temple St, a big hip-roofed rear block, and a hip-roofed rear-west wing with a two-storey porch in the notch between them.

248274494._comment: 58-60 West Main St: one OSM footprint holding two attached buildings. Left (+v, NW) half is #60, a long yellow clapboard two-storey house with a squared false front over its street gable and a full-width two-storey porch (open ground floor on thin posts, white balcony rail, yellow-and-white striped awning under the porch roof). Right (-v, SE) half is #58 Puppy's Bar & Grill, a teal front-gabled two-storey with a brick ground floor, a shingled pent canopy and the gold-on-green PUPPY'S sign; a low white shed behind it. Road face is +u (SW, West Main St).

248361683._comment: 65 East Main St: NOT brick - a pale yellow-green clapboard two-storey house with a low hip roof and cream trim, converted to a shop. A one-storey enclosed front porch with a hip roof runs the full width and wraps into a one-storey east (+v) wing; two big dark-framed display windows and a centre-left cream door with steps sit under it. A two-storey gabled rear wing behind. Road face is +u (NNE, East Main St); the Avon Inn is the -v neighbour.

1090362839._comment: 77 Genesee St: NYS Assemblywoman Andrea Bailey's district office. Narrow 2-storey gable-front (ridge running back from the street) in grey-beige brick; ground floor storefront with vertical blinds between rock-faced tan stone piers, glass door + white apartment door at the right, white fascia with the navy office sign; three tall white windows upstairs; white raking fascia on the gable. Party wall with the Park Theater block (1090362840) on -v; alley on +v. Road face +u; left (0) = +v = SSW.

248251393._comment: 119 Genesee St: 2.5-storey olive Queen Anne with a hip roof, a steep front gable (arched attic window) over the left half of the street face, cross gables on both long sides, a full-width open porch with white posts and railing, red steps, and a round-arched siding opening at the right end of the porch leading to the dark red front door. Stone foundation. Road face +u; left (0) = +v = SSW (toward 121 Genesee).

249550114._comment: Small grey-roofed outbuilding/garage in the parking lot behind the Park Theater block (1090362840). Not visible in any Street View capture; modelled plain from the overhead. Road face +v faces the back of the theater; doors put on the parking-lot sides (-v, +u).

248251394._comment: 102 Genesee St (The Foot Doctor): greige gable-front 2-storey block on the SSW half, 1.5-storey cross-gabled wing on the NNE half, full-width white open porch (top-level, spanning both front volumes on the shared wall u=6.2) with a small gabled entry pediment, 1-storey rear wing behind the wing. +u = street (WNW), +v = NNE.

porches._comment: full-width front porch across both front volumes; left (NNE, +v) to right fractions along the porch; steps centred on the door at v=0.76

248342263._comment: 37 North Avenue: one-storey beige vinyl ranch set 40 m back from the road behind a big tree. T-plan: hip-roofed bar along the NNE (-v) side, gabled stem toward the SSW (+v) with two arched-head windows in its gable end, small gabled entry at the inside corner. +u = ESE (road), +v = SSW.

248251392._comment: 121 Genesee St: white clapboard 2.5-storey American Foursquare. Hip roof in dark grey-green shingle, a wide green-shingled front gable dormer (roof.dormers on the hip's -v slope) with a round-arched window, red brick chimney right of the dormer, full-width open porch with white posts and railing and centred steps to a dark front door. Rear wing carries a cross gable whose end (with a small arched attic window) faces the +u driveway side. Road face -v; left (0) = +u = SSW (away from 119 Genesee).

248342264._comment: 55 North Ave: tan stucco 2-storey Colonial Revival box under a silver standing-seam side-gable roof (ridge along u, parallel to the street). Three-bay front: wide triple windows flanking a centred door with sidelights and a gabled white two-column portico; three 1/1 sash upstairs. Long orange wooden wheelchair ramp from the sidewalk to the door. One-storey glazed sun porch with a silver hip roof on the +u (SSW, left-as-seen-from-street) side near the front. Road face -v; left (0) = +u = SSW.

247541851._comment: 40 East Main St (corner of North Avenue): big grey-sided 2.5-storey American Foursquare. Pyramidal hip roof with hipped dormers on the front, east and west slopes, centre chimney; full-width front porch on Tuscan columns (+u, East Main), which continues along the east side as a porte-cochere over the driveway (-v). Two-storey square bay on the North Avenue face (+v). Two-storey gabled rear wing and a one-storey hip kitchen wing at the north-west corner, small rear stoop at the north-east. Black shutters, white trim. Road face by distance is +v (North Avenue); the real front is +u.

248342243._comment: 18 North Avenue: sage-green Dutch Colonial with cream trim. Side gambrel (ridge along u, parallel to the street) with two gabled dormers in the steep front slope, a centred front-facing cross gambrel (barn-shaped gable) with a triple window and attic window, and a full-width raised porch on Tuscan columns with white railing and central steps to a dark oval-glass door. Stone foundation. One-storey rear wing at the east. Body eave at the first floor (3.5 m); the upper floor lives inside the gambrel, its windows in the dormers and in the gambrel ends. Road face +v (west); left (0) = -u = north.

248342245._comment: 24 North Ave: 2.5-storey gable-front house, tan clapboard with a barn-red shingled front gable and butter-yellow trim; full-width open front porch with four square yellow posts and a red-and-yellow railing, steps to the left-of-centre door; paired attic window in the gable; brick chimney right of the ridge; red wall dormer on the +v (NNE) side toward the rear; rubble-stone foundation. Road face +u; left (0) = +v = NNE.

248342249._comment: 38 North Ave: small one-storey greige vinyl ranch under a low medium-grey hip roof. Front (road face -u): the left ~60% is a shallow open porch (slim posts, near-flat roof) sheltering a wide triple window and the white front door with a black barn star beside it; a twin window to the right of the porch. Lower hip-roofed rear wing offset to the +v (SSW) side, toward the detached garage. Road face -u; left (0) = -v = NNE (toward 42 North).
